chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: How they were introduced in 1924
summary: In those days you introduced yourself, and the young people visited each other's homes after dances.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Every time he'd come through there naturally we would see each other.
That was in 1924 when he came through there with
Who introduced you? Did he come up and talk to you or did you come up and talk to him?

No, in those days if you saw somebody you liked you'd go up and introduce yourself. (LAUGHTER) You can't do that now. ..... You know, you'd see something you liked you'd say, well - and you'd go out after the dances, we'd all go to each other's homes, something like that. Your mother would fix snacks for you, 'cause
we didn't have no joints to go to, anyway we were too young. Then he left and then after he came to New York I lost track of him.
